_note: parts are listed backmost first; that order is the z order. `seeds` are the authoritative cut hints (cell coords, y down, read off Tools/anim/sheet.py grid); `rect` is only a fallback when seeds are absent. `mirror_of` rebuilds a part its occluder hid, from its bilateral twin.

See DEFECTS.md OPEN #9. Lower this as the poses are reworked; do not raise it.
